goal: Allow running txindex on pruned nodes without retaining hundreds of gigabytes of raw block history
Enable pruned nodes to build a partial transaction index from their oldest retained block
Surface candidate block hashes when transaction lookups target pruned blocks so callers can fetch them
agreement: Substantive support for the concept across multiple reviewers
Concept approval for indexing transactions on storage-constrained nodes (ajtowns, arejula27, l0rinc)
Resolved objection by supporting index startup on already-pruned nodes (mzumsande)
Open suggestions on type modeling, edge-case tests, and error message formatting (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes the long-standing mutual exclusion between txindex and block pruning
Storage-constrained nodes can index transactions without keeping full raw block history

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because missing block hashes are exposed in structured error payloads for pruned lookups
Callers can automate on-demand block retrieval using getblockfrompeer
